about_the_game:
With over 90 pages of rich and intricate illustrations, this digital artbook brings to life the dark and mysterious world of Twilight Monk. 

Discover the many characters that inhabit the realm of Speria, with full color illustrations and concepts by the veteran game concept-artist himself, Trent Kaniuga. Each illustration accompanied with detailed descriptions and world building that bring the world to life, this is a must have for artists and gamers alike!

Once downloaded, you will find the Digital Artbook as a PDF in the game's local files.

How to access the art book:

1. Install Twilight Monk

2. Right-click Twilight Monk in your Steam Library and go to “Properties”

3. In the Properties window, go to “DLC” and confirm that “The World of Twilight Monk: Volume 1” is installed

4. In the Properties window, go to “Installed Files” and click “Browse...”

5. File Explorer will open and the "The World of Twilight Monk Volume 1 pdf" file will be saved in the "art book" folder!"
